remarks:
Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom single-family home bursting with opportunity! 
Step inside the main level to find a spacious carpeted living room, a formal dining room, a cozy family room, a main-floor bedroom, full bath, and an eat in kitchen featuring stylish vinyl hardwood flooring. Upstairs, you’ll find 2 additional carpeted bedrooms and a convenient 1/2 bath.
?Outside, enjoy off-street parking with your own private driveway and a fenced yard perfect for pets, play, or relaxation.  ?Situated just two houses across from Hyde Park, right off the bus line, and only 5 minutes from I-90, the location simply can't be beat for convenience and recreation. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer, looking for a second property, or adding a solid asset to your investment portfolio, this home is ready for you to make it your own. Don’t miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
